name: sample_stranger
speaker: Hooded Stranger
notes: The worked example: every condition (flag, !flag, flag value, time, activity, has, !has, met true, met by name) and every action (set, add, clear, give, take, end) appears at least once. The dialogue-graph gate walks it; docs/EDITOR_GUIDE.md explains it.

nodes.text: A traveller on the Harrowby road, and at this hour. Sit, if you like. This fire is the only warm thing between here and the smithy.
Back again. The road must be lonelier than it looks.
Third night running. Either you like my company or you have nowhere better to be. Sit down, then.
Well? Ask what you came to ask.

choices.text: Have you seen anything at the treeline?
You look thirsty. Take my flask.
I have nothing to defend myself with.
Agnes, you said. Would she talk to me?

nodes.text: Someone who walks at night so as not to be asked that. Agnes at the alehouse would tell you more than I will.
Look for yourself, it is dark enough. Lights, low down among the trunks, where nobody lives.
In daylight? Nothing but trees. Come back after dark and ask me again.
Water, to a stranger, on a dark road. No - hold still, I will not be in your debt. Take my spare hood; the nights are turning cold.
Then have this. It has been sharpened more often than it has been used, which is the right way round. Mind the edge.
Agnes talks to everyone. The trick is getting her to stop.
We are square, you and I. Safe roads.
The stranger is asleep by the fire, hood over their face. Better not.
